text: A hybrid ThreeDScene + VoiceoverScene pipeline that turns dense math (Bašić, "The Heesch number in E³ is unbounded", arXiv:2610.24281) into a narrated, frame-checked animation. The second scene re-imagined the same math as a flat vector "rings" visual with a dimension ladder and a big red No. card. Rendering is fully scripted: portable TinyTeX for pdflatex, cached narration mp3s for offline re-renders, and deterministic 480p15 drafts verified frame by frame before any 1080p60 final.

AI engineer building in-browser AI systems: local LLM inference, embeddings-driven retrieval, and evaluation-first workflows. Ships sites that run a real language model in the visitor's browser — no server, no API keys, no data leaving the device.

AI engineering. RAG (retrieval-augmented generation). LLM inference (WebLLM, wllama). Embeddings (sentence-transformers, all-MiniLM-L6-v2). Agent tooling (OpenCode, plugins, MCP). Python. TypeScript. Astro. React. Manim / technical animation. Git. Firebase Hosting.
